import json, os, time, urllib.error, urllib.request
raw = os.environ["BLAND_API_KEY"].strip()
if raw.startswith("{"):
    try:
        p = json.loads(raw)
        raw = next((p[k] for k in ("api_key", "key", "value") if p.get(k)), raw)
    except Exception:
        pass
BLAND = "https://api.bland.ai"
GW = "https://mott-booking-gw.mail.mybcat.com"
PATHWAY = "94abad8b-fbe2-4e67-9c64-d9b586dd2653"

def bland_post(path, payload):
    req = urllib.request.Request(BLAND + path, data=json.dumps(payload).encode(), method="POST", headers={"Authorization": raw, "Content-Type": "application/json", "User-Agent": "mybcat-cli"})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=180) as r:
        return json.loads(r.read().decode())

subject = {"recall_patient_id": os.environ["HARNESS_PATIENT_ID"], "recall_cell": os.environ["HARNESS_PATIENT_CELL"], "store": os.environ.get("HARNESS_STORE", "711"), "campaign": "harness"}
body = bland_post("/v1/pathway/chat/create", {"pathway_id": PATHWAY, "pathway_version": 92, "request_data": subject})
chat_id = body["data"]["chat_id"]
print("CHAT_CREATED=%s" % chat_id[-8:])
for turn in ("hi", "thursday please", "No the following Thursday"):
    r = bland_post("/v1/pathway/chat/%s" % chat_id, {"message": turn})
    node = (r.get("data") or {}).get("current_node_id")
    print("SENT=%r node=%s" % (turn, node))
print("WAIT=4s for Bland to commit the last message")
time.sleep(4)
auth = os.environ["GW_TOKEN"].strip()
if not auth.lower().startswith("bearer"):
    auth = "Bearer " + auth
gw_body = {"store": "711", "from": "friday", "to": "friday", "slot_minutes": "15", "after": "none", "before": "none", "time_pref": "none", "callID": chat_id}
req = urllib.request.Request(GW + "/availability", data=json.dumps(gw_body).encode(), method="POST", headers={"Content-Type": "application/json", "User-Agent": "mybcat-cli", "Authorization": auth})
try:
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=120) as r:
        payload = json.loads(r.read().decode() or "{}")
    res = payload.get("result") or {}
    slots = res.get("slots") or []
    dates = sorted({str(s.get("start", ""))[:10] for s in slots if s.get("start")})
    print("RACE_RESULT count=%s dates=%s" % (res.get("count"), ",".join(dates) if dates else "none"))
    print("INTERPRET: 08/06 dates -> deployed extract drops the negation (code drift in extract_date_from_text); 08/13 dates -> deployed resolves the correction correctly; friday dates (sentinel) -> deployed extract honored the negation and returned nothing, so the incident 08/06 came from the fetch race (correction not yet committed when the webhook fired)")
except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
    print("RACE_RESULT HTTP_%s %s" % (e.code, e.read().decode(errors="replace")[:200]))
print("PROBE_DONE")
PY
